connection.title: Connection
connection.intro: Folder sync uploads the folders you choose on this computer to your Teler files. It uses the account you're signed in to in Teler.
connection.disconnectBody: Sync stays off on this computer until you connect again. Your folders and files are kept, both on this computer and in Teler.
connection.sessionOnlyBody: No system keyring is available, so you'll need to reconnect folder sync after Teler restarts.

errors.signed-out: You're signed out of Teler. Folder sync connects once you sign in.
errors.connect-denied: The connection was declined in Teler.
errors.connect-expired: Connecting took too long. Try again.
errors.connect-failed: Folder sync couldn't connect. Try again.
errors.no-organization: Your Teler account isn't in an organization that sync can use.
errors.not-eligible: Folder sync isn't available for this Teler account.
errors.network: Teler can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid-folder: This folder can't be synced. Choose a different folder.
errors.invalid-destination: This destination isn't valid. Choose a different name.
errors.sync-failed: Something went wrong with sync. Try again.
errors.timeout: This is taking longer than expected.

folders.removeBody: Files already uploaded stay in Teler, and nothing is deleted from this computer.
folders.otherAccountHint: This folder syncs to a different Teler account. Stop syncing it, then add it again to sync with this account.

addFolder.description: Choose where this folder's files go in Teler.
addFolder.invalidName: Use a single folder name without “/” or “\”.
addFolder.nothingToUpload: No files can upload yet. New files will sync as they appear.
addFolder.exclusionsNote: Secrets, dependencies and build folders are skipped by default, and a .telerignore file in the folder is respected.
